# participation role

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:participationRole`](gmeow-participationRole.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/participationRole>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The role(s) the participant played, drawn from the open [`gmeow:ParticipantRole`](../classes/gmeow-ParticipantRole.md) value vocabulary. NON-FUNCTIONAL — mirroring [`gmeow:eventType`](gmeow-eventType.md): a participation may bear several roles, and competing standpoint-indexed role claims coexist ([`accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md)) rather than contradict ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). Generalizes the former hasPrincipal / hasWitness / hasOfficiant subproperties.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Participation`](../classes/gmeow-Participation.md) -> [`gmeow:ParticipantRole`](../classes/gmeow-ParticipantRole.md)

### Wedding

- **Source:** [`slices/core/events/examples/wedding.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/events/examples/wedding.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-events-examples-wedding)#example-slices-core-events-examples-wedding

```turtle
# --- Reified participations: the two principals and the officiant, with roles.
#     A withdrawn or disputed role would coexist as another Participation
#     (displayable false, or standpoint-indexed) — never overwritten (P9/P10).
ex:partAlex a gmeow:Participation ;
    gmeow:participationEvent ex:wedding ;
    gmeow:participationParticipant ex:alex ;
    gmeow:participationRole gmeow:roleParticipantPrincipal .

ex:partSam a gmeow:Participation ;
    gmeow:participationEvent ex:wedding ;
    gmeow:participationParticipant ex:sam ;
    gmeow:participationRole gmeow:roleParticipantPrincipal .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record which [`gmeow:ParticipantRole`](../classes/gmeow-ParticipantRole.md) value(s) a participant played in an event — officiant, witness, performer — assigning several when the part is genuinely several roles at once.

### Avoid when

- Avoid reviving a per-role subproperty (gmeow:hasWitness and kin were refactored into role values, [Principle 6](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-6)) and avoid collapsing disputed roles — keep it non-functional so standpoint-indexed roles coexist via [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md).

### How to use

- Point the [`gmeow:Participation`](../classes/gmeow-Participation.md) at one or more [`gmeow:ParticipantRole`](../classes/gmeow-ParticipantRole.md) individuals; carry a contested role on its own statement with [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) + [`gmeow:confidence`](gmeow-confidence.md) rather than choosing a primary.

### Examples

- ex:p1 [`gmeow:participationRole`](gmeow-participationRole.md) [`gmeow:roleOfficiant`](../individuals/gmeow-roleOfficiant.md), [`gmeow:roleWitness`](../individuals/gmeow-roleWitness.md).
